text:
Branded-residence development in the Caribbean and Latin America is concentrated among luxury hotel operators. The **most commonly associated brands** are:

### Established regional leaders
- **The Ritz-Carlton / Ritz-Carlton Reserve**
- **Four Seasons**
- **St. Regis**
- **Rosewood**
- **W Hotels & Residences**

These consistently rank among the leading hotel brands in the Americas by completed and pipeline residential projects. Marriott International—through Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis, W and other flags—is the region’s largest hotel parent company in this sector. ([pdf.euro.savills.co.uk](https://pdf.euro.savills.co.uk/global-research/branded-residences-americas-23-24.pdf?utm_source=openai))

### Other frequently encountered luxury brands
- **Fairmont** and **Raffles**
- **One&Only**
- **Aman**
- **Mandarin Oriental**
- **Six Senses**
- **Banyan Tree**
- **Auberge Resorts Collection**
- **Waldorf Astoria** and, to a lesser extent, **Conrad**
- **Park Hyatt**, **Andaz** and **Thompson Hotels**
- **Kimpton** and **InterContinental**
- **SLS** and **Mondrian**
- **Nobu**

Examples include Fairmont Heritage Place Mayakoba, One&Only Mandarina Private Homes, Rosewood Residences Mayakoba, Six Senses developments in Mexico and Grand Bahama, and Waldorf Astoria residences in Costa Rica, Mexico and Turks & Caicos. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/news-releases?item=124592&utm_source=openai))

### Additional Marriott flags appearing in newer projects
- **Autograph Collection**
- **The Luxury Collection**
- **EDITION**
- **JW Marriott**

Marriott formally supports residential products across a broad range of its luxury and lifestyle brands, although Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis and W remain the most recognizable regional residential flags. ([marriott.com](https://www.marriott.com/luxury/about-us?utm_source=openai))

### Practical development shortlist
For a typical luxury resort or second-home project, the initial competitive set would usually be:

1. Four Seasons  
2. Ritz-Carlton or Ritz-Carlton Reserve  
3. St. Regis  
4. Rosewood  
5. One&Only  
6. Fairmont  
7. Aman or Six Senses  
8. W, SLS or Thompson for a more lifestyle-oriented concept  
9. Waldorf Astoria or Park Hyatt  
10. Auberge, Banyan Tree or Kimpton for a smaller, differentiated project  

The appropriate brand ultimately depends on positioning: **Four Seasons, Ritz-Carlton, St. Regis and Rosewood** for traditional luxury; **Aman, One&Only and Six Senses** for ultra-luxury resort and wellness concepts; and **W, SLS, Thompson, Andaz and Kimpton** for lifestyle-oriented developments. Hotel brands still account for roughly four-fifths of the global branded-residence sector. ([knightfrank.com](https://www.knightfrank.com/research/article/2025-09-08-the-global-branded-residence-survey-2025?utm_source=openai))
